flow: Pharma distributor rolled out SFA + Distribution with full batch tracking, expiry management and cold-chain telemetry across 18 DCs.
Regulatory reporting required batch-level traceability to the end retail point. Existing system tracked only to distributor level, forcing 3 analysts to reconcile manually each month.
Batch and expiry tracking at SKU level across the whole chain. IoT temperature sensors integrated with shipment records. Automated regulatory reporting.
99.7% traceability accuracy — audit-ready in minutes, not days. Expiry wastage fell 65% from better FIFO enforcement.
